title: Backup and restore
intro: Boba keeps your data on this computer. A backup is one passphrase-encrypted file that opens on any system, so it is your recovery if this machine is lost.
error.load: The backup settings could not be loaded.
error.action: That did not complete. Nothing was changed.
status.required: This build is not signed by Apple or Microsoft, so Boba cannot recover your data without a passphrase-protected backup. Onboarding cannot finish and no search runs until one exists.
create.title: Create a backup
create.intro: Choose where to save the file and a passphrase. The passphrase is the only thing that opens it — Boba cannot recover it for you.
create.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.intro: Restoring replaces all current data. Boba checks the file first and keeps a snapshot of what it replaces.
restore.confirm: I understand that this replaces everything on this computer.
restore.done: Restored the backup created {date}. The previous data was saved as {snapshot}.
reset.title: Reset everything
reset.intro: This permanently deletes the database, every snapshot, the automation browser profile with its session cookies, and the keychain entries. It cannot be undone — make a backup first if you might want this data.
reset.db_kept: The database file could not be unlinked while Boba runs. Its content was erased and its key removed, so nothing readable is left.
reset.uninstall: Uninstall notes: remove {path} and uninstall Boba from your system's app list. Nothing else is kept.
